title: Null Awareness Axis — the line between tail and 3rd eye
discovery: every animal has a tail except Vitruvian man. The chipmunk must paint its tail.

null_axis.definition: the line from tail ? body center ? 3rd eye ? nose
null_axis.back_half: NULL — the blind zone. The animal cannot see behind itself.
null_axis.front_half: AWARE — nose, 3rd eye, focal convergence. The seen world.
null_axis.transition_point: 3rd eye (pineal position) — where blind becomes aware

tail.who_has_one: every animal — fish, reptile, bird, mammal, even tadpoles
tail.who_doesnt: only adult humans (Vitruvian man). The coccyx is the vestigial remnant.
tail.chipmunk_tail: bushy, striped brown/cream, curves upward. Painted from memory — it can't SEE it.
tail.monkey_tail_as_exhaust: the tail is a steam engine exhaust — balance, cooling, signaling. Same as SEO channels.

blind_zone.what: the back of the body — behind the head-turn sweep
blind_zone.why_null: no eyes face backward. Even with head-turn oscillation, ~120° is permanently null.
blind_zone.shoulder_mobility: glenohumeral joint + rotator cuff = 360° reach. No other animal has this.
blind_zone.cooperation_origin: you scratch my back, I'll scratch yours — literal origin of reciprocal altruism
blind_zone.the_mirror_problem: to see your own back you need a mirror OR a friend. Same as debugging your own code.

third_eye.position: on the null axis, between the two optical eyes, slightly above
third_eye.pineal_gland: the physical 3rd eye — photosensitive in many species (tuatara, lamprey). Regulates circadian rhythm.
third_eye.axis_crossing: the 3rd eye sits WHERE the null axis crosses from blind to aware. It's the threshold.
third_eye.in_chipmunk: drawn as a purple circle at the transition point on the null axis

vitruvian_connection.da_vinci_drew_no_tail: the only animal body in Western art drawn without one
vitruvian_connection.coccyx_as_vestige: 3-5 fused vertebrae. The tail was reabsorbed. The exhaust was internalized.
vitruvian_connection.cauda_equina: the nerve bundle INSIDE the spinal canal IS the internal tail. Latin: 'horse's tail'.
vitruvian_connection.human_uniqueness: no external tail + can scratch own back = closed-loop self-maintenance

connections.head_turn_spectrum: the chipmunk sweeps L?R to see ears + nose. The null axis is what it STILL can't see after the sweep.
connections.hands_unsure: it tried to draw its hands (the drawing instrument) and couldn't. Same principle: the observer can't observe the observing tool.
connections.tailbone_exhaust: from previous feed — monkey tail = steam engine = coccyx = SEO channels
connections.print_scan_loop: if you print the chipmunk including its back, the printer CAN see the back. The machine has no blind zone.

scyborg_triple_license.ORC: null axis is a game mechanic — every creature has a blind zone it must account for
